analysis: The code snippet defines a private method `resolveViews` that takes an array of table/view names and returns a set of underlying table names. It iterates over the input array, converting each name to lowercase. If the lowercase name is a key in `mViewTables`, it adds all elements from the associated collection to the `tables` set via `addAll`. Otherwise, it directly calls `tables.add(name)` to add the original name. The API documentation describes the `add` method of the `Set` interface, which may throw four exception types. The actual set used is a `HashSet<String>`, which supports the `add` operation, permits null elements, and does not impose class or property restrictions on elements. Therefore, none of the declared exceptions can be thrown from the `add` call in this context.
